scope.reviewed: 完整中文摘要、中文标题及全部quicklook字段与逐字英文quote；身份、数字、单位、分母、阴性结果、研究设计和关联/因果措辞。

checks.title: 中文标题保留中国、多中心前瞻性登记研究；源标题没有需保留的数字。
checks.designAndInterpretation: 登记队列、主要与次要结局及过程指标均保留；系统/文化因素仅表述为可能影响，未改成确定因果。
checks.negativeResultsAndLimits: 源摘要无明确局限段；速读如实注明。

quoteChecks.quote: Among 17 602 patients (median age, 66 years; 65.5% male), the annual incidence of adult IHCA was 4.1 per 1000 admissions.
Among all patients, 16 872 (95.9%) received cardiopulmonary resuscitation within 1 minute;
Overall, 1610 (9.1%) patients survived to 30 days or discharge, with 1241 (7.1%) having a favorable neurological outcome.
At 12 months, 1075 (6.1%) patients remained alive, and 986 (5.6%) had a favorable neurological outcome.

checks.title: PCI后替格瑞洛单药或阿司匹林联合普拉格雷及网状Meta分析均保留；标题无数字。
checks.designAndInterpretation: 频率学派随机效应网络合并及经替格瑞洛DAPT间接比较明确；未写成直接头对头试验。
checks.negativeResultsAndLimits: 保留临床意义的MACCE风险增高不能排除、非劣效性未达到及需要直接随机比较；糖尿病交互未增加源摘要没有的方向。

quoteChecks.quote: Ticagrelor monotherapy and aspirin plus prasugrel were compared indirectly through ticagrelor-based DAPT.

Ticagrelor monotherapy showed similar MACCE compared with aspirin plus prasugrel (IRR: 1.09; 95% CI: 0.86-1.38), although a clinically meaningful increase in risk cannot be excluded (P for noninferiority = 0.33);
major bleeding was lower with ticagrelor monotherapy (IRR: 0.54; 95% CI: 0.37-0.80).
An interaction between P2Y12 inhibitor strategy and diabetes status was observed for MACCE (Pint = 0.04).

checks.title: 难治性或未控制高血压、治疗比较、随机试验网状Meta分析均保留；标题无数字。
checks.numbersUnitsDenominators: 核对≥2种药、检索至2025年11月、系统综述35项/8,648例/12治疗与网络分析30项/8,187例/10治疗；诊室SBP变化、螺内酯MD -12.43 mm Hg/95%可信区间-17.68至-7.18，射频肾去神经MD -8.74/-12.96至-4.52，CINeMA均中等。
checks.designAndInterpretation: 贝叶斯随机效应、主要结局及难治性/较广未控制人群均保留；相对于基线治疗的效应与附加治疗之间的比较区分清楚。
checks.negativeResultsAndLimits: 明确头对头比较未见显著差异/多数仍包括无效可能；未从排名推出治疗优越性。结论列baxdrostat来自原文。

quoteChecks.quote: We included 35 trials (8,648 patients and 12 individual treatments) in the systematic review and 30 trials (8,187 patients and 10 individual treatments) in the network meta-analysis.

In patients with resistant hypertension, spironolactone (mean difference: -12.43 mm Hg; 95% credible interval: -17.68 to -7.18; CINeMA moderate) and radiofrequency renal denervation (mean difference: -8.74 mm Hg; 95% credible interval: -12.96 to -4.52; CINeMA moderate) were more effective than baseline treatment in reducing office systolic blood pressure.
Similar findings were observed in patients with uncontrolled hypertension.
No intervention demonstrated clear superiority over another because most head-to-head comparisons included the possibility of no effect.

quoteChecks.quote: CRT response was significantly higher in patients without LGE than in patients with LGE (78.7% vs 50.7%; P < 0.001).
The absence of LGE was strongly associated with higher CRT response (OR: 3.52; 95% CI: 2.54-4.88; P < 0.001) and much lower arrhythmic risk (OR: 0.06; 95% CI: 0.02-0.15; P < 0.001).
In this subgroup the incremental benefit of CRT with defibrillator over CRT-P may be limited.

checks.title: 更新Meta分析、LAAC与口服抗凝、房颤卒中预防均保留；标题无数字。
checks.numbersUnitsDenominators: 核对90%左房血栓、2026两试验使随机证据超过翻倍、检索至2026-04-15；6 RCT/2014–2026/358中心/7028例、华法林2试验/DOAC4试验、高出血风险2试验/消融后1试验；总体卒中OR 1.10/0.78–1.56，缺血性卒中1.41/1.07–1.86，非操作出血0.58/0.35–0.96，注册号CRD420261370546。
checks.designAndInterpretation: 随机效应合并累积发生率的比值比、预测区间、预设亚组与试验序贯分析保留；总体卒中相近未写成卒中预防等效。
checks.negativeResultsAndLimits: 缺血性卒中信息量不足、仅非操作出血达到充分信息量、获益未见于高出血风险组及人群适用范围均保留。

quoteChecks.quote: Overall stroke rates were similar between arms (odds ratio, 1.10 [95% CI, 0.78-1.56]).
Ischemic stroke was more frequent with LAAC (odds ratio, 1.41 [95% CI, 1.07-1.86]) but did not reach the required information size.

Nonprocedural bleeding was lower with LAAC (odds ratio, 0.58 [95% CI, 0.35-0.96]), the only outcome reaching a sufficient information size, in standard-risk and postablation but not high-bleeding-risk patients.

checks.title: AF合并HF、房室结消融后两种起搏方式及CONDUCT-AF均保留；标题无数字。
checks.designAndInterpretation: 研究者发起、多中心随机非劣效设计、独立核心实验室、意向性原则及左束支区域CSP均保留；非劣效结论限定6个月LVEF改善。源文用“.4%”，稿件逐字数字和单位保留，未擅自改换效应量。
checks.negativeResultsAndLimits: 临床/超声指标及复合终点相当为源摘要表述，未写成总体优效或已证实等效；摘要无明确局限段。

quoteChecks.quote: The between-group difference was .4% (95% CI -3.1-3.8; P = .002 for non-inferiority).
Changes in left ventricular volumes, clinical parameters, and composite endpoint of worsening HF or cardiovascular death were comparable between groups.
Paced QRS [mean difference -14 ms (95% CI -19 to -9; P < .001)] and procedural and fluoroscopy times were significantly shorter with CSP compared with BVP.

checks.title: 复发及QoL预测因素、台湾多中心登记及24个月随访均保留；中文摘要标题及quicklook标题都保留24个月。
checks.designAndInterpretation: 登记、连续入组、间歇ECG/Holter/事件记录器/临床指征评估、Cox及QoL配对完整病例均保留；诊断至消融时间为复发相关/预测指标，未主张缩短等待必然减少复发。
checks.negativeResultsAndLimits: 无心脏压塞/房食管瘘、EQ-5D-3L无显著变化、LVEF边缘负关联p=.052、QoL缺失及稀少事件/准完全分离致模型不稳定、无法确认稳健VAS独立预测因素均保留。

quoteChecks.quote: Kaplan-Meier recurrence-free survival under intermittent monitoring was approximately 90% at 12 months and 62% at 24 months, with wider confidence bands beyond 18 months.
In multivariable analysis, longer time from AF diagnosis to ablation independently predicted recurrence (adjusted HR 1.050 per year, 95% CI 1.007-1.096; p = 0.023);
QoL analyses in 205/298 patients with paired data showed no significant change in EQ-5D-3L index (p = 0.672), but VAS categories shifted toward lower symptom burden (moderate/high 21.5% to 10.2%).
